mapper.select:
select DISTINCT co.order_code, co.ord_status, co.order_time, co.accept_node locationNode, co.subscriber_code, co.customer_name, co.valid_time, co.invalid_time, co.tenant_id, co.accept_node locationCode, c.`platform_name` locationName, (case when compro.dept_level = '3' then comAll.dept_name else compro.dept_name end) as provinceName, (case when comcty.dept_level = '5' then compro.dept_name else comcty.dept_name end) as cityName from vm_order_customer co inner join vm_order_package cp on co.order_code = cp.order_code left join sys_dept comcty on comcty.dept_id = co.business_org left join sys_dept compro on compro.dept_id = comcty.parent_id left join sys_dept comAll on comAll.dept_id = compro.parent_id left join `vm_platform_data_config` c on co.accept_node = c.`platform_code` and c.delete_flag = 0
left join vm_order_devices do on do.order_code = co.order_code
left join vm_order_sensor_devices osd on osd.order_code = co.order_code
left join vm_order_sensor_devices radarOsd on radarOsd.order_code = co.order_code
left join vm_order_uav_devices uav on uav.order_code = co.order_code
left join vm_order_uav_nest_devices nest on nest.order_code = co.order_code
left join vm_order_horn_devices horn on horn.order_code = co.order_code
left join vm_order_recorder_devices recorder on recorder.order_code = co.order_code
left join vm_order_algorithms ao on ao.order_code = co.order_code
left join vm_order_services_rel serrel on serrel.order_code = co.order_code
WHERE co.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
and do.device_code like CONCAT('%', #{deviceCode}, '%')
and do.device_name like CONCAT('%', #{deviceName}, '%')
and osd.category_code = 2 and osd.device_code like CONCAT('%', #{sensorDeviceCode}, '%')
and osd.category_code = 2 and osd.device_name like CONCAT('%', #{sensorDeviceName}, '%')
and ao.algorithm_name like CONCAT('%', #{algorithmName}, '%')
and radarOsd.category_code = 1 and radarOsd.device_name like CONCAT('%', #{radarName}, '%')
and radarOsd.category_code = 1 and radarOsd.device_code like CONCAT('%', #{radarCode}, '%')
and uav.device_name like CONCAT('%', #{uavName}, '%')
and uav.device_code like CONCAT('%', #{uavCode}, '%')
and nest.device_name like CONCAT('%', #{uavNestName}, '%')
and nest.device_code like CONCAT('%', #{uavNestCode}, '%')
and horn.device_name like CONCAT('%', #{hornName}, '%')
and horn.device_code like CONCAT('%', #{hornCode}, '%')
and recorder.device_name like CONCAT('%', #{recorderName}, '%')
and recorder.device_code like CONCAT('%', #{recorderCode}, '%')
and serrel.service_code = '9' and serrel.service_name like CONCAT('%', #{satelliteName}, '%')
and co.ord_status in
#{item}
AND STR_TO_DATE(co.order_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') >= #{startTime}
AND STR_TO_DATE(co.order_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') <= #{endTime}
and co.accept_node = #{locationCode}
${dataScope}
order by co.order_time
desc
asc
order by co.valid_time
desc
asc
order by co.invalid_time
desc
asc
order by co.order_time desc
select count(1) from vm_order_customer cp where cp.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and cp.delete_flag = '0' and ord_status in (0,1,2)
select code_path from `vm_platform_data_config` where platform_code = #{locationCode} and delete_flag = 0
select platform_level from vm_platform_data_config where platform_code = #{locationCode} and delete_flag = 0

select platform_code from vm_platform_data_config where platform_level != 0 and delete_flag = 0 and platform_code in
#{item}
select count(*) from vm_order_customer where admin = #{userName} and accept_node = #{currentAcceptNode}
select platform_code from vm_platform_data_config where code_path like CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{acceptNode}), '%')
